jo: Morning! first-day-ish. quick question — trying to get secrets for local dev + CI. I tried auth at `vault.redwood.ai` and got a 403. who should I ping to get access? :wave:

maya: Welcome @jo! :wave: Ping devex for the access. Do you already have your IAM user and SSO groups set up? Also you'll need to create a request for the specific project.

jo: IAM and SSO look fine on my end. what's the request flow? is there a self-serve portal or do I need someone to open it?

devex: hey @jo — we have self-serve for most dev requests. steps:
1) go to https://secrets.redwood.internal/request and pick the "dev-secrets" template for your project.
2) attach a short justification + your manager's approval.
3) after approval, run the CLI auth:
```
# login to secrets proxy
rwdx secrets auth login
# fetch a value
rwdx secrets kv get path=teams/redwood-sandbox/DB_URL
```
If you prefer I can open the request for you; send me the exact project name.

devex-bot: Ticket #S-48291 created for josephine (dev-secrets request) — assigned to devex oncall, expected SLA 8h.

lina: security note: dev credentials are short-lived by design (default TTL 8h). For CI you should use KMS-wrapped repo variables — format in repo settings is `REDWOOD_DB_URL: kms:alias/redwood/ci` so the CI platform pulls and decrypts at runtime.

sam: for Terraform state we encrypt with a dedicated KMS key (`alias/redwood/tf`) and enforce through a repo tag `secrets:tf-state`. if your work touches infra, let me know the repo and I'll add the tag and an IAM role.

jo: helpful — thanks. couple more quicks: how often do we rotate secrets? who owns rotation? and can I get a temporary db user instead of a full connection string in env?

lina: rotation policy: application-level secrets — 90 days (owners rotate via the portal). KMS keys — annual rotation, auto-rotate enabled for most customer/infra keys. emergency rotation: file an incident in #incidents and security will coordinate a key roll and live rekey of affected services. owners are responsible for updating apps after rotation.

devex: for temp DB creds we provide a DB-proxy that issues short-lived users. example: `rwdx db temp-user --ttl 2h --role readonly` which returns JSON creds you can inject into your local env or CI job. we recommend using that for dev and test clusters.

maya: also note for dedicated customer test clusters there is an extra legal + security approval step — we'll surface that in the request template when applicable.

jo: perfect. @lina @devex tagging you for follow-up. I'll try the portal now and report back. thanks all! :thumbsup:

lina: sent you a DM with the permission checklist and the org KMS alias list. also posted a shorthowto in #devex-docs.

devex: updated ticket S-48291 to in-progress. ping if you still see 403 after we approve.

jo: got it — will confirm later today. :raised_hands: closing this thread once I verify access.
